chars.SISTER: a Moroccan young woman about 25 with long dark wavy hair, wearing an oversized mustard-yellow hoodie and light blue jeans
chars.NARRATOR: a Moroccan young man about 23 with short curly black hair, wearing an olive-green bomber jacket over a white t-shirt and black joggers
chars.MOM: a Moroccan woman about 55 with thick round glasses, a beige hijab and a dark brown djellaba
chars.COUSIN: a Moroccan woman about 28 with heavy makeup and a high black ponytail, wearing a burgundy satin blouse and black wide trousers
chars.AUNT: a Moroccan woman about 55 wearing a light grey house kaftan and a white headscarf

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated illustration, vertical. Seen from a half-open bedroom doorway: SISTER sits on her bed in a modest Moroccan bedroom at night and quickly hides her glowing phone behind her back, startled, eyes wide, guilty look toward the viewer. Head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible, subject centered, calm background edges. No text.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated illustration, vertical. Close-up of NARRATOR standing in a dim apartment hallway, frowning with suspicion, one eyebrow raised, looking toward a closed bedroom door. Subject centered, calm background. No text.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated illustration, vertical. NARRATOR and MOM sit side by side in the back of a white Moroccan grand taxi on the road to Kenitra, MOM holding a small travel bag on her lap, NARRATOR looking out the window thoughtfully. Daytime, fields outside. Subjects centered. No text.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated illustration, vertical. On a Moroccan city street in Kenitra, MOM with thick glasses squints and holds NARRATOR's arm tightly as he guides her carefully toward the entrance of a modest apartment building. Afternoon light. Subjects centered, faces visible. No text.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated illustration, vertical. Inside a Moroccan apartment entrance: COUSIN has just opened the door and freezes when she sees MOM, embarrassed, looking down and pulling at her blouse, cheeks red; MOM looks at her through her thick glasses with a cold surprised expression. Head-to-waist framing, both faces visible, subjects centered. No text.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: 2D animated illustration, vertical. Late at night in a small Moroccan kitchen: AUNT tilts an empty blue butane gas bottle and shakes it with an annoyed face, a pot of uncooked tagine sits on the cold stove, MOM sits at the small table, NARRATOR stands in the doorway watching. A wall clock shows midnight. Subjects centered. No text.
